title: manilkara balata var. hartii
intro: Manilkara balata var. hartii, commonly known as the Jamaican dogwood, is a plant species in the Sapotaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as reducing anxiety and insomnia due to its sedative effects. The therapeutic actions of Jamaican dogwood are attributed to its ability to act as an anxiolytic and a sedative, which is thought to be due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as scopoletin and scopoletin glucoside, which have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. However, further research is necessary to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Jamaican dogwood for medicinal purposes.
